thread:
sam_design: quick design scrub on the pool form: i'm leaning away from only an asterisk. what about a small inline label like 'Required' in monospace/brackets? feels more explicit on hover and in low-vision modes
isha: +1 to explicit text. tiny glyphs disappear on high contrast or when zoomed. 'Required' also reads well when labels wrap
marc: can we keep the small visual indicator (for dense forms) but show the word 'Required' in tooltip or on focus? reduce visual noise but keep clarity
kara_pm: product ask  we need to avoid extra DOM bloat for mobile. maybe show the word only when the field is focused or if device width > 720px
a11y-bot: a11y reminder: programmatic indication required: element.setAttribute('aria-required', 'true') and ensure label is linked with for/id. if using tooltip, provide aria-describedby pointing at tooltip element
sam_design: implementation compromise proposal: show minimal colored dot next to label always; on focus or hover expand to 'Required' text + short reason for policy-driven fields. provide persistent helper text for complex fields only (eg. dataset id format)
isha: sounds reasonable. add developer note: avoid using placeholder text to indicate required state or examples
marc: deletion flow question: current modal says "Delete pool" + checkbox "I understand". should we require typing the name for prod pools only?
kara_pm: propose risk-based confirmation: <10GB  single confirm + undo toast; >=10GB or flagged prod  require typing name and show linked resources summary
a11y-bot: typed confirm needs clear label and live region announcing mismatch/errors. also make sure the input is reachable by keyboard and has an autocomplete="off"
sam_design: also show exact consequences summary (eg. 'This will remove snapshots, references in X projects'). helps teams decide without digging
isha: one more nit  error placement. inline errors below the field for single-line messages; for multi-field failures (eg. cross-field validation) show a top summary banner with link anchors to offending fields
marc: agree. keep inline for per-field, banner for cross-field. also auto-focus first invalid field on submit
kara_pm: good direction. kara will approve the pattern if devs confirm aria-describedby and focus behavior. sam will mock a compact + expanded variant for mobile and desktop and post in thread
a11y-bot: token update notice: design-token "indicator-contrast" changes tomorrow, verify new value meets 4.5:1 for small indicators
sam_design: thanks all, i'll post mocks in ~2h and put acceptance checklist (aria-required, aria-describedby, focus order, undo toast policy)
